headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: EBITDA remained broadly flat at INR 41.7 cr, while EBITDA margins moderated to 8.3% from 8.5%, amid steel price volatility, supply disruptions and ramp-up costs.
PAT declined 4.9% YoY to INR 30.7 cr, impacted by higher depreciation following capacity additions and lower interest income as funds were deployed towards capex.
H1FY27 revenue and EBITDA increased 10.7% YoY to INR 965 cr and INR 81.1 cr, respectively.
Order book increased to INR 2,011 cr as of October 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over approximately 10–11 months.
valuation: HSS capacity stands at approximately 25,000 tonnes annually, targeted to reach 75,000–80,000 tonnes by December 2027.
Near-term margin improvement will remain limited by HSS and export development costs, while management targets 11–12% EBITDA margins within two years.

Valuation: We assign a BUY rating on Interarch Building Solutions with a target price of INR 2,382 based on 17x P/E, implying an upside of 50% from the current market price of INR 1,583 over the next 24 months.
watch: Interarch operates primarily in the B2B segment, offering design, manufacturing, and turnkey construction services to corporate, industrial, and institutional clients.

Steel pass-through provisions, stricter payment terms and better overhead absorption are expected to improve profitability and reduce execution risk. • Capacity Expansion Progressing: Gujarat PEB Phase 1 and Andhra Pradesh HSS Phase 1 were commissioned during H1FY27, with management indicating that both Gujarat phases are now operational.
